title.en: MiniMax H3 video line restored with tier groups
title.zh: MiniMax H3 视频专线恢复上架并新增档位分组

summary.en: `minimax-h3-video` is available again on the AutoDL H3 line. One public ID now serves three tiers through request-scoped groups: standard (1.0×), `minimax-h3-video-fast` (0.9×) and `minimax-h3-video-pro` (1.15×). Billing stays per requested second at 0.025 USD/second, and the newest endpoints accept a `mode` parameter.
summary.zh: `minimax-h3-video` 在 AutoDL H3 线路恢复上架。同一个公开 ID 通过请求级分组提供三个档位：标准档 1.0×、`minimax-h3-video-fast` 0.9×、`minimax-h3-video-pro` 1.15×。计费仍按请求时长 0.025 USD/秒，最新端点新增 `mode` 参数。

body.en:
**MiniMax H3 video line** (`minimax-h3-video`) is available again, served by AutoDL ComfyUI workflows.

## Restored

- **Model ID:** `minimax-h3-video`
- **Contract:** `POST /v1/videos`, polled through `GET /v1/videos/{task_id}` (plugin line: the path differs from the other video series models, and `/v1/video/generations` returns 503)
- **Tiers:** standard (default, 1.0×), `minimax-h3-video-fast` (0.9×), `minimax-h3-video-pro` (1.15×)
- **Billing:** 0.025 USD/second (¥0.17/second at FX 6.8); `raw_quota = 0.025 × 500000 × seconds × GroupRatio`

## Capabilities and limits

- One ID selects its endpoint from the request shape: text-to-video, image reference, image + audio, lip sync and first-last frame. When nothing matches it returns 400 instead of silently falling back.
- The fast and higher-quality tiers serve image reference and image + audio only, capped at 768p.
- Offered resolutions are 480p / 736p / 768p. 1080p and the higher upstream tiers have no published price and are not offered.
- Duration is 1–15 seconds (default 5); some shapes cap at 10 or 12 seconds.

## New parameter

- `mode` (`高速模式` / `高质模式`, default `高质模式`): accepted by the nine-image and nine-image-three-audio endpoints added on 2026-10-23.

## Documentation

- [MiniMax H3 video line](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
body.zh:
**MiniMax H3 视频专线**（`minimax-h3-video`）恢复上架，由 AutoDL ComfyUI 工作流承载。

## 恢复上架

- **Model ID：** `minimax-h3-video`
- **接口契约：** `POST /v1/videos`，通过 `GET /v1/videos/{task_id}` 轮询（插件型线路，路径与视频系列其它模型不同；误用 `/v1/video/generations` 会返回 503）
- **档位：** 标准档（默认，1.0×）、`minimax-h3-video-fast`（0.9×）、`minimax-h3-video-pro`（1.15×）
- **计费：** 0.025 USD/秒（¥0.17/秒，FX 6.8）；`raw_quota = 0.025 × 500000 × 秒数 × GroupRatio`

## 能力与限制

- 同一 ID 按请求形态自动选端点：文生视频、多图参考、多图多音频、对口型、首尾帧；没有候选时返回 400，不静默降级。
- 高速档与升级画质档只覆盖多图参考与多图多音频，分辨率上限 768p。
- 公开分辨率档为 480p / 736p / 768p；1080p 与更高的上游档位没有已发布价格，不开放。
- 时长 1–15 秒（默认 5 秒），部分形态上限 10 秒或 12 秒。

## 新增参数

- `mode`（`高速模式` / `高质模式`，默认 `高质模式`）：2026-10-23 新增的九图与九图三音端点接受该参数。

## 文档

- [MiniMax H3 视频专线](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
